turns.text: Hello, I just opened my delivery and the print has a deep crease along the corner.

I'm sorry your print arrived creased. To look into this, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I've verified them, I can file a damage claim. Staff will then ask you for a photo of the crease and decide the next step with you.
Order SC-4090, email is emily.clark.v2@example.com. Please file a damage claim for a refund.

Thank you, Emily. I've filed a damage claim (R-1) for your order SC-4090, the Whispering Pines print, asking for a refund. The crease along the corner is noted. Staff must approve the request. They will ask you for a photo of the damage before they decide, so please keep the print and its packaging until then.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Print 'Whispering Pines' (40x50 cm) arrived with a deep crease along the corner.

turns.text: Actually, I really love the art itself. Could I please get a reprint instead of a refund?

Of course, Emily. I've changed your claim R-1 for order SC-4090 from a refund to a reprint of the Whispering Pines print. It is still pending, and staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the crease before they decide.
